_metadata.description: Closed-loop greedy autosteer controller: diagnose test-genie findings, greedily select the heaviest open dimension's skill, execute via agent-manager, re-measure, and terminate on objective / diminishing-returns / budget — with decision-trace transparency and an anti-gaming promote-safety gate (OT-P0-002, OT-P1-003).

requirements.title: Termination gates: objective, diminishing returns, budget
requirements.description: The MEASURE/TERMINATE step stops the loop when the objective is met (no findings above severity, operational targets gated), when mean improvement falls below the diminishing-returns floor, or when the iteration/token budget is exhausted — and continues while net-improving.

requirements.title: Closed-loop convergence end-to-end
requirements.description: A full DIAGNOSE→SELECT→EXECUTE→MEASURE mini-loop shrinks the open-findings set and terminates, and the budget cap halts a non-converging loop.

requirements.title: Greedy skill selection by heaviest open dimension
requirements.description: Within the heaviest open dimension (profile weight × open severity), the controller runs the first eligible skill that targets it, resolved deterministically from the skill→dimension map; selection is fully explainable and stalls on no eligible skill rather than looping.

requirements.title: Anti-gaming promote-safety gate
requirements.description: The gameguard classifier inspects each run's code-level diff and stamps a gaming_cause on the decision trace; a run with any gamed iteration is blocked from shadow→live promotion (RunGamed). Gameguard never alters selection.

requirements.title: Surface the decision trace (API/CLI/UI)
requirements.description: The per-iteration decision trace (chosen skill, heaviest dimension, score before/after, realized delta, gaming_cause, halt reason) is durably persisted and exposed via the GET /auto-steer/execution/{taskId}/trace API, the 'steer trace' CLI command, and the UI decision-trace panel; skill→dimension coverage gaps are surfaced to operators.
